verdict.rationale: Openness of source code is a fair question for a payments platform, so the axis applies. The evidence pack has no statement that Checkout.com's platform source is available under an open license. The only GitHub item is an official Node.js SDK, which is a client library rather than the product's source, and no license is cited for it.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
